title: Decrement machine on underflow
statement: Let $k$ be a number of work tapes, choose one tape $i$, and let $x$ be an input word and $w$ a Boolean word. Suppose fixed-width decrement of $w$ underflows, the initial configuration $d$ is in the run phase, and tape $i$ agrees with the buffer storing $w$ at every offset $p$ from its head position with $-1\le p\le |w|$. After $2|w|+2$ steps, the decrement machine is in the done phase with flag false; on tape $i$, the cells from the initial head position through the next $|w|-1$ cells contain $|w|$ true bits, and all other tape contents are unchanged. It has not reached either done phase at any earlier time, and through that time tape $i$'s head stays between one cell left of its initial position and the initial position plus $|w|$, inclusive; every other tape head remains fixed.
